constraints: n3..100;directed adjacency rows;old graph strongly connected;proposal may disconnect;A,B0..10;all ordered pairs new<=A*old+B;LOCAL output includes old directed diameter;0 sentinel.
independentMethod: Run independent BFS from every source in both directed graphs, checking finite reachability, affine bounds and original diameter; cross-check random directed distance matrices against Floyd.
